newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close mixed, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close mixed, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed mixed on higher supplies as picking of K-68 variety at farms in Punjab province started, dealers said.
Ginning factories were likely to get 100,000 bales of raw cotton daily, dealer Nasim Usman at the private Karachi Cotton Association said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,000 to 2,150 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said. Rates fluctuated according to the cotton variety.
